collection.title: Chevrolet Aveo Hatchback 2012 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Chevrolet Aveo 2012 - 2020 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 15" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Aveo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
